E0353

A `validate { … }` rule statement isn't `check(cond, at: field, "msg")` (D-VALIDATE1)

What

A `validate { … }` rule statement isn't `check(cond, at: field, "msg")` (D-VALIDATE1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0353

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0353: tests/ui/validate_bad_rule_shape.stderr.

Error [E0353]: a `validate` rule must be `check(condition, at: field, "message")`
  --> tests/ui/validate_bad_rule_shape.jet:6:9
    |
  6 |         print("hello")
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: D-VALIDATE1: every statement in a `validate { … }` block is a `check` call — the first argument is the rule's condition, `at:` names the field the failure is reported against, and the last argument is the message text
 Fix: write: check(<condition>, at: <field>, "<message>")
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0353

Error [E0107]: nothing named `Signup` exists here
  --> tests/ui/validate_bad_rule_shape.jet:1:8
    |
  1 | struct Signup {
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `Signup :: ...`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0107
